about: What OSV (and NVD, where OSV could not answer for Graphviz) publishes against the Graphviz inside @viz-js/viz and against @viz-js/viz, for the versions in "queried". Written by node scripts/engine-version.mjs --refresh, never by hand; the weekly workflow and the release both run it. The check reads this file offline, and fails if it was made for another engine or lists a flaw that affects this one.
